lines.text: This shop is the real deal.

data.define: Used for something that is authentic and good.

example.text: This shop is the real deal.

misuse.text: Don't call a cheap copy 'the real deal'.
misuse.why: It means genuine and truly great.

publish.title: What does "the real deal" mean?
publish.value: The real deal = Truly genuine and great. Example: "This shop is the real deal." (casual English, US).
